messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] us-west-2 /v1/generate p95 latency spike >1200ms — paging oncall (auto-escalation)
alex_oncall: oncall here, seeing alerts. digging into top hosts now.
alex_oncall: quick telemetry: 30% of requests hitting a few GPU VMs with CPU steal and high load. KV cache hit rate dropped ~40%.
priya_infra: confirmed. node-gpu-37 and node-gpu-42 showing high host CPU and iowait. networking counters fine. suspect GC / host-level contention from background maintenance.
jamal_runtime: rolling logs for recent deploys — no new model rollouts in last 2h. runtime shows increased batch time due to repeated cache misses + long tail tokenization on some requests.
alex_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) mark node-gpu-37/42 drain, 2) scale up warm pool by +3 GPUs in us-west-2, 3) enable routing fallback to smaller-quantized model for non-SLA customers. executing now.
priya_infra: draining node-gpu-37 -> cordon + migrate active sessions (pv2 commands run). scaling warm pool +3 — provisioning started. ETA ~6-8 min for instances.
deploy-bot: Action: cordon node-gpu-37 (user: priya_infra) — ok. Start instances x3 in us-west-2 (user: priya_infra) — provisioning.
alex_oncall: enabling routing policy fallback for lower-tier traffic: route -> model-xq-1 (compatible) to reduce per-token latency. applying rule: /v1/generate, tier!=enterprise -> fallback.
jamal_runtime: toggled fallback rule; metrics show immediate reduction in queue time for routed traffic.
emily_support: any customer impact? Support queue picking up tickets about slow responses from a few customers in us-west.
ops_lead: Emily, please get a rapid customer notification draft. Keep it short and factual; mention limited region impact and mitigation steps.
emily_support: Draft for status page — please review:

"We are investigating elevated request latency affecting the /v1/generate endpoint in the us-west-2 region. Some customers may experience slower responses. Engineers have identified overloaded GPU hosts and are draining affected machines. We have initiated additional capacity and enabled routing fallbacks to reduce impact. We expect most customers to see improvement within 15-30 minutes. We will update as we have more information."

ops_lead: good. Suggest adding: "If your application requires guaranteed latency, consider switching to dedicated capacity or pin to enterprise tier." short note only.
emily_support: Updated status page copy ready. I'll publish now — pinging you after publish.
alex_oncall: quick internal comms template for teams:
- Impact: increased p95 latency for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (affects ~12% of traffic)
- Root cause: host-level CPU contention causing KV cache misses and long tail batch times
- Mitigations: drained 2 unhealthy hosts; scaled warm pool +3; enabled fallback routing for non-enterprise traffic; monitoring
- ETA: progressive improvement within 15-45 minutes; full recovery variable depending on instance provisioning
- Action items: eng/runtime to validate KV cache warmup, infra to validate host health post-provision, support to send customer update

priya_infra: new nodes healthy and joined cluster. provisioning completed.
jamal_runtime: KV cache warming showing +20% hit rate after migration. p95 across region down from 1200ms -> 420ms on average for routed traffic.
alex_oncall: continuing to monitor. leaving drain in place for node-gpu-42 until we confirm stability.
emily_support: status page published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1950009999 — posted in customer-facing channel and emailed impacted customers list (low-latency customers flagged).
ops_lead: good work. Prepare post-incident note with timeline and RCA. Alex, can you start the doc? I'll take ownership of customer follow-ups.
alex_oncall: copying brief timeline into incident doc now. Handoff to priya at 1950010800 for follow-up and deeper host analysis.
priya_infra: ack. I'll check host telemetry and schedule a maintenance window if hardware noisy.
jamal_runtime: will run a quick regression test for tokenization path and KV warmup scripts. noting a potential optimization for cache prefetch.
alex_oncall: final note before handoff: observed a small increase in error 5xx for long streaming sessions — mitigation: throttle long-poll streams for fallback cohort. implementing a short-term limit.
ops_lead: handing off oncall to priya_infra. Alex, thanks. Priya, you'll coordinate closure and postmortem.
priya_infra: taking over. will run follow-ups and tag eng/runtime on RCA. closing pager for oncall.
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged as resolved for oncall. Pager closed (auto).
